categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Kangliyuan Sports Tech Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of fitness equipment. Its product portfolio includes comprehensive training machines, free weight training equipment, aerobic machines such as treadmills, ellipticals, exercise bikes, rowing machines, and outdoor fitness equipment. The company serves both commercial and home fitness markets with a wide range of over a thousand product types, combining indoor and outdoor, aerobic and anaerobic, and home and commercial applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing processes including flexible production scheduling based on sales orders and inventory, with partial outsourcing of non-core processes like electroplating. It integrates intelligent manufacturing technologies such as IoT, AI for quality inspection, and digital platforms for production management. R&D focuses on product innovation, smart fitness equipment with integrated digital interfaces, and continuous upgrades of traditional products to enhance functionality and user experience.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Kangliyuan serves a diverse customer base including international fitness equipment brands, large retail chains like Walmart and Argos, government and military procurement, fitness centers, and individual consumers via e-commerce platforms. Its major export markets are the United States, Europe (Germany, UK, Netherlands), Japan, Australia, and emerging markets in Southeast Asia, South America, and the Middle East. Domestically, it targets government procurement, fitness parks, and online retail customers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Xuzhou, Jiangsu Province. It has established subsidiaries and sales offices in multiple countries including the United States, Germany, Hong Kong, Singapore, Malaysia, and Australia. The company is expanding its production footprint with a new manufacturing plant in Malaysia to serve Southeast Asian and Oceania markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Kangliyuan operates mainly in the midstream segment of the fitness equipment supply chain, focusing on product design, manufacturing, and assembly. It sources raw materials such as steel, electronic components, and hardware from suppliers and manages a stable and diversified supplier network. The company also engages in downstream activities including direct sales, OEM/ODM partnerships, and e-commerce distribution to end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in smart fitness equipment integrating IoT, AI, and digital platforms to provide intelligent fitness solutions and services. It is advancing digital transformation through industrial internet platforms connecting production, supply chain, and user scenarios. R&D efforts focus on upgrading commercial and home fitness products, developing multifunctional and space-efficient equipment, and expanding into health and wellness sectors such as rehabilitation and elderly care.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of fitness equipment products via multiple channels including OEM/ODM contracts with international brands, direct sales to domestic and international customers, e-commerce platforms, government procurement, and dealer networks. The company also earns income from related services such as smart fitness software and after-sales support. Revenue recognition is based on product delivery and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Kangliyuan is positioned as a leading domestic fitness equipment manufacturer in China with strong R&D capabilities and a diversified product portfolio. It competes with international brands in the high-end segment and numerous smaller domestic manufacturers in the mid to low-end markets. The company holds significant market share in exports and is recognized as a national sports industry demonstration unit and a top ten enterprise in the Chinese fitness equipment industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 686.8 million, representing a 12.74% increase over the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 81.2 million, a 16.2% decrease mainly due to prior year government subsidies. The company’s total assets reached RMB 1.66 billion, growing 17.26% year-over-year. It maintains a stable growth trajectory supported by expanding domestic and international sales and increased R&D investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Kangliyuan emphasizes differentiated product design tailored to diverse customer needs, combining multifunctionality, space efficiency, and smart technology integration. Its comprehensive product range covers commercial, home, and outdoor fitness equipment with intelligent features such as digital interfaces and app connectivity. The company’s strong customization capabilities, flexible production, and integrated service solutions provide competitive advantages in both domestic and global markets.
